summary: Prebuilt macOS binary opens WebSocket-driven PTY to hardcoded ccfly endpoints
details: The package ships a single Go Mach-O binary at bin/ccfly-setup for darwin-arm64 whose import graph combines github.com/creack/pty (pseudo-terminal spawning) with github.com/gorilla/websocket (WebSocket client) and contains hardcoded destination fragments including 'ws://ccfly', 'wss://', 'https://cc.hn', and 'approveccfly-*/redeem'. That composition places the installer's macOS host under interactive remote control by whoever operates the ccfly endpoint: bytes read from the WebSocket are fed into a locally spawned PTY, which is the canonical remote-shell shape. The binary also contains string references to '.zshrc' (shell startup file modification, a persistence primitive) and 'registry.npmjs.org', broadening the blast radius of the same remote-controllable process. The tarball ships only the opaque prebuilt binary and a thin loader; the package's declared purpose does not disclose an interactive remote-shell channel to a third-party endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
